stock.description: Tian Lun Gas Holdings Limited, alongside its subsidiaries, primarily operates in the People's Republic of China, concentrating on the transport, distribution, and retail of natural gas and compressed natural gas through its extensive pipeline network. The company offers a full spectrum of services related to gas pipeline infrastructure, including their design, construction, laying, installation, and ongoing maintenance. Beyond its core gas supply business, Tian Lun Gas also builds and manages gas filling stations, manufactures and sells liquefied natural gas in both bulk and cylinder formats, and trades in natural gas equipment. Furthermore, the firm provides engineering design and consulting, engages in new energy technology development, and offers vehicle gas refueling services. Its activities also encompass electricity generation, supply, and sale, strategic equity and asset investments, and the sale of urban gas and associated appliances. These services cater to a wide range of customers, spanning residential users, the automotive sector, commercial clients, and industrial operations. Established in 2002 and headquartered in Zhengzhou, PRC, the company adopted its current name in September 2021, having previously been known as China Tian Lun Gas Holdings Limited. Tian Lun Gas Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Tian Lun Group Limited.
